scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc --build && pnpm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.join('src','scripts','ocr-worker.py'); const dst=path.join('dist','scripts','ocr-worker.py'); if(!fs.existsSync(src)){ console.error('missing '+src); process.exit(1); } fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst),{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src,dst); console.log('copied ocr-worker.py -> dist/scripts/ocr-worker.py');"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\"); for (const path of [\"dist\", \"tsconfig.tsbuildinfo\"]) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
